message:
hepta: prepare original Root generation assembly for review

Bind the original protected host session, issuer, Registry lease, Artifact and FinalUse owners to one initial generation operation. Preserve the once-state and original publication/readback/recovery paths, then consume the same Ready through the existing task factory.

Add a read-only complete binding request, six protected-owner mechanism cases, and explicit caller/source-contract registrations while preserving the original boundary rows, protected rules and first 48 Root parents. Include the independently reviewed request-type import correction.

This exact candidate is unformatted and uncompiled. No collector, source/native qualification, ordinary cross-process learning chain or process-cold recovery is claimed. E2 transport and normal startup integration remain in progress; source refs and the original b608 execution contract are unchanged.
